name: goahead
description: A one-key 진행하죠: when Claude ends a turn with a question, a button and ⌥↩ send your configured reply.

reply.title: Reply
reply.description: The text sent as your prompt.

key.title: Send key
key.description: Sends the reply while a question is pending. Modifiers ctrl, alt (option), shift joined with +, then the key.

patterns.title: Question patterns
patterns.description: Case-insensitive regex alternation matched against the last paragraph of Claude's final message. An invalid regex falls back to the default.
patterns.default: 할까요|드릴까요|진행할까요|시작할까요|괜찮을까요|어떻게 할까요|shall I|should I|want me to|proceed\?

requireQuestionMark.title: Require question mark
requireQuestionMark.description: When on, only a message ending with ? or ？ counts as a question.
